# testdata

Test images for the forked `image/jpeg` decoder/encoder in `../jpeg`.

The files are copied unmodified from the Go standard library
(`$GOROOT/src/image/testdata`, Go 1.27.3), the same source the `../jpeg` code
was forked from, and are covered by the Go BSD-style license
(https://go.dev/LICENSE). Only the files referenced by `../jpeg/*_test.go` are
kept.
